surface_mechanism_description: An alternating supply of TMG and NH3 provides higher surface diffusion velocities of the Ga adatoms to locate themselves at proper atomic sites. Growth by alternate supply of reactants is dominated by a surface kinetics limited process rather than a mass transport limited process. In a self-limiting process, only partially cracked NH radicals instead of atomic nitrogen are required for the accomplishment of adsorption processes. For NH3, the thermal energy for forming partially cracked NH radicals is less than that for the formation of atomic nitrogens.
